### Datasets

```{python}
#| tags: [noclear]
country = pl.read_csv("data/countries.csv")
country_geo = DSGeo.read_file("data/countries_polygons.geojson")
country_geo
```



```{python}
city = pl.read_csv("data/countries_cities.csv")
city = DSGeo.from_latlon(city)
city
```



```{python}
ocean = DSGeo.read_file("data/oceans.geojson")
```



```{python}
DSGeo.explore(ocean)
```


```{python}
geo_dist = (
    DSGeo.sjoin_nearest(city, ocean, distance_col="dist", crs="ESRI:54009")
    .with_columns(dist = c.dist / 1000)
    .sort(c.dist)
)
```



```{python}
(
    geo_dist
    .pipe(DSGeo.sjoin, country_geo)
    .join(country, on=c.iso)
    .with_columns(is_coastal = (c.dist < 25))
    .group_by(c.subregion)
    .agg(
        prop_coastal = (c.pop * c.is_coastal).sum() / c.pop.sum()
    )
    .sort(c.prop_coastal)
)
```

```{python}
(
    geo_dist
    .pipe(DSGeo.sjoin, country_geo)
    .join(country, on=c.iso)
    .with_columns(is_coastal = (c.dist < 25).cast(pl.Int64))
    .pipe(DSGeo.explore, column=c.is_coastal)
)
```


```{python}
country_meta = (
    geo_dist
    .pipe(DSGeo.sjoin, country_geo)
    .join(country, on=c.iso)
    .with_columns(is_coastal = (c.dist < 25))
    .group_by(c.iso)
    .agg(
        prop_coastal = (c.pop * c.is_coastal).sum() / c.pop.sum()
    )
    .sort(c.prop_coastal)
)

(
    country_geo
    .join(country_meta, on=c.iso)
    .pipe(DSGeo.explore, column=c.prop_coastal, tooltip=[c.iso])
)
```
